title: Hand won prospects to customer success without losing issue history
description:
As a customer-success owner, I want won prospects retained with their sales history so follow-up continues after a sale.

Feature: Customer-success handoff
  Scenario: Continue follow-up after a sale
    Given a prospect with contact, salesperson ownership, comments and sales history
    When an authorized user performs the configured customer transition and assigns customer-success follow-up
    Then the same full Kanbus issue ID and prior history are preserved
    And the customer-success view uses ordinary configured filters
    And ownership and next follow-up survive a backend reload

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Backend handoff proof passed against the real local shared Kanbus process with unmodified Prospectus configuration and synthetic data. The prospect begins with salesperson ownership, contact email and a sales-discovery comment; it moves through contacted, qualified, proposal and customer, receives customer-success ownership and an onboarding next action, and survives a process restart/catalog rebuild with the same issue ID, contact and both comments. An ordinary type=prospect/status=customer board query returns the record. A stale write conflicts; replay does not duplicate the handoff comment; conditional deletion retains the audit history.

The shared runtime is merged through Kanbus PR #399 and Virtuus PR #33. The application owner still owns the customer-success UI acceptance; this records the completed backend portion without claiming that broader application story is closed.
